title: Uniqueness of the prescribed integral Roos limit
statement: For a normalized DVR tower T and an integral constructible object M satisfying IntegralDualizingLimitPresentation l E D hl X T M.obj, the presented object M.obj is isomorphic to the chosen derived limit (integralDualizingLimit l E X).obj T.tower.

proof.text: Unpack the presentation triangle hM and the canonical Roos triangle supplied by integralDualizing_roos_model. Their transition endomorphisms and product terms agree. Rotate the distinguished triangles and use triangulated triangle-isomorphism uniqueness, then transport through the shift equivalence to obtain an isomorphism of the first objects.

lean.statement: theorem integralDualizing_mapping_tower_limit_roos_iso (T : NormalizedDVRTower l E X D hl) (M : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X) (hM : IntegralDualizingLimitPresentation l E D hl X T M.obj) : Nonempty (M.obj ≅ (integralDualizingLimit l E X).obj T.tower)
